title: What is video as code?
music_prompt: calm minimal modern tech underscore, no vocals, loopable

beats.say: Recording and editing is the bottleneck. Not ideas.
So I stopped recording. The script became the whole video.
Each line of narration gets one visual, cut to the exact word.
An AI voice reads it, free tools assemble it, and a finished video falls out.
No camera. No editor. Just a script you can change like code.
